title: On the Suitability of LLM-Driven Agents for Dark Pattern Audits
reasoning: The paper evaluates the performance of LLM-driven agents in auditing web interfaces for 'dark patterns' (manipulative designs) based on CCPA regulations. Although it utilizes normative criteria and harm mechanism mapping to classify these designs, the study is a technical audit of external web content for regulatory compliance rather than a benchmark of the models' internal moral, ethical, or religious values.
